items.title: f) Identification of Iron (II) radical (Fe²⁺) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: f) Identification of Iron (II) radical (Fe²⁺): a main subheading of 16.7 Tests for identification of basic radicals, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 347-347.

blocks.text: Saaf test tube mein 4 g sample lein. 10 cm³ distilled water mein ghol lein. Do hisson (parts) mein baant lein.

blocks.caption: Iron (II) radical ki pehchan
rows: Pehle hisse mein NaOH solution dalein.
Sabz precipitate banta hai jo kuch der baad orange brown (narangi-bhoora) ho jata hai.
Doosre hisse mein aqueous ammonia dalein.
Fe(OH)₂ ka safed gelatinous precipitate banta hai jo jaldi hawa se oxidize ho kar Fe(OH)₃ ka laal-bhoora precipitate ban jata hai.

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Fe(OH)₂ hawa ki oxygen se dheere dheere Fe(OH)₃ mein badalta hai; isi liye sabz (ya halka) precipitate kuch der baad orange-bhoora ho jata hai. Saaf Fe(OH)₂ safed hota hai magar aam taur par lab mein halka sabz nazar aata hai.
